description: Allegion plc is a leading global provider of security products and solutions that keep people and assets safe and secure in the places they live, learn, work and connect. It offers an extensive and versatile portfolio of security and access control products and solutions across a range of market-leading brands, including door controls, door control systems and exit devices such as panic hardware for life safety, together with electronic security, access control and identity solutions, delivered worldwide as hardware, software, services and systems by its experts and tailored to end-user security needs.
